name: Palawan Tit
rangeDescription: Southwestern philippines (balabac, calauit, and palawan)
description: A small bird of wooded areas on Palawan and neighboring islands, with a full black hood, yellow underparts, a black wing with two white wing-bars and edges, and a black tail with a white tip and outer tail feathers. Back is bright yellow in males and olive in females.

name: Yellow-eared Parrot
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia and northern ecuador
description: Endangered macaw-like parrot found in Andean cloud forest. Likely only occurs in Colombia now, but formerly ranged as far south as central Ecuador.

name: Many-spotted Hummingbird
rangeDescription: East slope of the andes from ecuador to southern bolivia and northwestern argentina
description: Large hummingbird of Andean cloud forest. Ranges along the east slope of the Andes from far southern Colombia south to Bolivia.

name: Lord Howe Rail
rangeDescription: Highlands of lord howe island (endangered)
description: A long-necked and short-tailed rail with a long decurved bill. Uniformly brownish red, sometimes with variable barring on underside and flanks.

name: Eastern Parotia
rangeDescription: Northern watershed of papua new guinea (waria to milne bay)
description: A fairly large, short-tailed bird of mid-montane forest canopy. Male is mainly black with a bronzy-scaled chest and 6 antennalike feathers projecting from the back of the head.

name: Yellow-capped Weaver
rangeDescription: Southern cameroon to gabon, central african republic, and northeastern democratic republic of the congo
description: A yellow-and-black weaver. Male has a distinctive golden crown and upper back, but the lower back and tail are black.

name: White-faced Plover
rangeDescription: Breeds coastal southeastern china; also vietnam (1 nest); winters to coastal southern vietnam, southern thailand, malay peninsula, singapore, and eastern sumatra
description: A small, pale plover with sandy upperparts, pinkish-colored legs, and a black bill. Male in breeding plumage has a mostly rufous crown and small black marks on top of the head and at the sides of the breast.

name: Ranongga White-eye
rangeDescription: Forest of ranongga (west-central solomon islands)
description: Small. Olive-green above and banana-yellow below and on throat.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Yellow-winged Vireo
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama (western chiriquí)
description: Small yellowish bird; note bold wingbars and face pattern with short pale eyebrow and arc under the eye. Yellow underparts sometimes bright, sometimes paler whitish, but always some yellow tones.

name: Chinchipe Spinetail
rangeDescription: Northwestern peru (upper marañón and chinchipe valleys)
description: Handsome spinetail restricted to the Marañon Valley in northwestern Peru. Note spotted breast sides, indistinct pale eyebrow, and chestnut wings and tail.

name: Rufous-banded Owl
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to venezuela, ecuador, peru, and bolivia
description: Uncommon medium-sized owl found in the subtropical and temperate zones of the Andes from Venezuela to Bolivia. Patterned with rufous, dark brown, and white overall.

name: Lance-tailed Manakin
rangeDescription: Southwestern costa rica to northern colombia and northern venezuela, including isla margarita
description: Striking black bird with cerulean back and red cap. Short tail with long spiky central feathers.

name: Archbold's Newtonia
rangeDescription: Subdesert of southwestern madagascar
description: Energetic and pugnacious little brown vanga. There is rufous around the eye, which is pale, and the underparts have a buffy tinge.

name: Gray-backed Tern
rangeDescription: Islands in tropical pacific ocean
description: A medium-sized tern of the tropical Pacific. Similar to Sooty Tern, but the back is gray (not black) and the white patch on the forehead extends behind the eye.

name: Nanday Parakeet
rangeDescription: Pantanal of southeastern bolivia, southwestern brazil, paraguay, and northern argentina
description: Medium-sized, mostly green parakeet with a black hood, red thighs, and blue in the wings and tail. Native to central South America, where it is found in open woodlands and grasslands with scattered trees.

name: Western Sandpiper
rangeDescription: Breeds siberia and alaska; winters to northern south america
description: Small sandpiper with relatively long, droopy bill (longer on females). In breeding plumage, shows rich rufous tones on shoulders, cheeks, and crown.

name: Caracas Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Coastal mountains of northern venezuela (aragua to miranda and western sucre)
description: A typical tapaculo, in bad light a plain and dark small bird with short tail. In good view, mostly plain dark gray with brown and slightly barred belly.

name: Spectacled Finch
rangeDescription: Himalayas (kashmir to nepal and sikkim)
description: Bizarre and unique-looking finch. Note the lumpy diagnostic patch of bright color around the eye and forehead: red in males, yellow in females.

name: Dusky Grasswren
rangeDescription: Rocky spinifex hills of central australia
description: Small rusty-brown bird with finely streaked plumage and long cocked tail, found in rocky areas and gorges around spinifex clumps of central Australia, including Alice Springs and Tennant Creek. Upperparts rusty brown, underparts slightly paler brown, the adult female showing a small rusty flank patch.

name: Seram Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Southern moluccas (boano, seram, ambon, and saparua)
description: A big pigeon with a green back and tail, a pale gray head and underparts, and a noticeable white eye-ring. Inhabits a limited range in the south Moluccas.
